summary: The IDF eliminated Hamas operatives using Kamal Adwan Hospital for terror activities in northern Gaza. Tensions between Israel and Iran are escalating following claims of Israeli tactical flights over Iran and Iranian threats of preemptive strikes. Turkey is reportedly preparing to deploy troops and air defense systems to Saudi Arabia.
key_points: The IDF eliminated Hamas operatives, including sniper Muhammad Tamous, who used Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza to plant explosives (Source: @idf_telegram/25307).
Iranian army spokesperson stated that Iran will conduct preemptive attacks if necessary to prevent future enemy strikes (Source: @kianmeli1/93055).
Reports claim Israeli Air Force conducted tactical flights over a restricted, undeclared area in Iran (Source: @kianmeli1/93049).
Turkey is preparing to deploy troops, pilots, aircraft, and air defense systems to defend infrastructure in Riyadh and holy cities in Saudi Arabia (Source: @shin_persian/10825).
Houthi forces allegedly targeted Aden airport's runway and passenger terminal with two ballistic missiles and explosive drones (Source: @shin_persian/10830).
US Vice President JD Vance stated Iran must significantly reduce uranium enrichment capacity to end the war (Source: @VahidOnline/78644).
Hamas and Hezbollah marked the third anniversary of Operation Al-Aqsa Flood (Source: @presstv/209837).

sections.executive_summary: The IDF eliminated Hamas operatives in northern Gaza who were utilizing Kamal Adwan Hospital to plant explosives. Tensions are rising between Israel and Iran amid reports of Israeli tactical flights over Iranian territory and Iranian threats of preemptive strikes. Regional security is shifting with Turkey preparing to deploy military assets to Saudi Arabia.

points: The Iranian army spokesperson stated that the country will carry out preemptive attacks if necessary to prevent potential enemy strikes (Source: @kianmeli1/93055).
Reports indicate Israeli Air Force aircraft performed a series of tactical flights over a restricted and undeclared area within Iran (Source: @kianmeli1/93049).
An Iranian official told Reuters that Iran will never waive its right to enrich uranium, though enrichment details could be discussed later (Source: @yediotnews25/135904).
President Pezeshkian is scheduled to visit Turkmenistan on Friday to attend the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (Source: @SharghDaily/187995).
President Pezeshkian held a telephone call with Vladimir Putin to congratulate him on his birthday and discuss strengthening bilateral strategic cooperation (Source: @SharghDaily/187993).
Helicopter activity was reported over Pardis in Tehran Province at 13:54 local time (Source: @shin_persian/10836).
An unmarked Boeing 747 freighter was spotted flying west over Tabriz in East Azerbaijan Province at 0948Z (Source: @shin_persian/10822).
Prime Minister Netanyahu and Military Intelligence Chief Shlomi Binder reportedly expressed confidence that Iran will attack Israel before the November elections (Source: @rodast_omiddana/82075).
IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir stated that the IDF must always be prepared for surprise wars, citing the failures of the Yom Kippur War and October 7 (Source: @yediotnews25/135901).
700 soldiers from the Paratroopers Brigade took an oath of allegiance at the Western Wall (Source: @amitsegal/65569).
A memorial square was completed at Zikim Beach to commemorate those killed and murdered on October 7 (Source: @almogboker78/18368).
Former Defense Minister Moshe Ya'alon called for a commission of inquiry to investigate Qatari funds (Source: @N12chat/228848).
The IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives who exited Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza; one was planting explosives in the 'Yellow Line' area (Source: @idf_telegram/25307).
The eliminated operative, Muhammad Tamous, was a sniper in the Hamas military wing who posed as a civil defense worker (Source: @idf_telegram/25307).
The IDF claims Hamas systematically violated the ceasefire by using the hospital to promote terror plots and restore capabilities (Source: @idf_telegram/25307).
Hezbollah marked the third anniversary of Operation Al-Aqsa Flood, describing it as a turning point in the Palestinian struggle (Source: @presstv/209837).
Abdul-Malik al-Houthi claimed the Saudi regime is pressuring Lebanese official circles to buy positions and incite against Hezbollah (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/397703).
The Lebanese Army conducted a detonation at the Qlaia field, which was heard in the south (Source: @redlinkleb/46873).
Chaos was reported in the Iraqi Parliament following a Central Bank decision to reduce the exchange rate of the Dinar (Source: @naya_foriraq/92852).
The large market in Al-Hilla, Babylon province, experienced near-total paralysis following the exchange rate change decision (Source: @naya_foriraq/92853).
Turkey is preparing to deploy troops, air defense systems, pilots, and aircraft to Saudi Arabia to defend Riyadh, holy cities, and infrastructure (Source: @shin_persian/10825).
Turkish forces in Saudi Arabia intend to avoid direct intervention in Yemen (Source: @shin_persian/10825).
Houthi forces allegedly targeted the Aden airport runway and passenger terminal with two ballistic missiles and explosive drones, diverting a flight to Jeddah (Source: @shin_persian/10830).
At least two airstrikes were reported in Sanaa according to local reports (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7973).
key_developments: IDF eliminated Hamas sniper Muhammad Tamous and another operative using Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza to plant explosives (Source: @idf_telegram/25307).
Iranian army spokesperson announced the possibility of preemptive attacks to prevent future enemy strikes (Source: @kianmeli1/93055).
Israeli Air Force reportedly conducted tactical flights over a restricted, undeclared area in Iran (Source: @kianmeli1/93049).
Turkey is preparing to deploy military personnel and air defense systems to Saudi Arabia to protect Riyadh and holy cities (Source: @shin_persian/10825).
Houthi forces allegedly launched two ballistic missiles and drones at Aden airport, forcing a flight diversion to Jeddah (Source: @shin_persian/10830).
US Vice President JD Vance demanded a meaningful reduction in Iran's uranium enrichment capacity as a condition for ending the war (Source: @VahidOnline/78644).
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated Iran has missed multiple opportunities for a nuclear deal and continues funding Hezbollah (Source: @VahidHeadline/646).
gulf_states.threat_assessment: The threat level is high due to the cycle of tactical flights and preemptive strike threats between Israel and Iran. The use of medical facilities by Hamas in Gaza continues to drive IDF kinetic operations. Houthi ballistic missile activity targeting Yemeni infrastructure indicates ongoing volatility in the southern theater.
gulf_states.regional_response: Turkey is shifting its posture by preparing military deployments to Saudi Arabia to secure critical infrastructure. The US is maintaining a hardline stance on Iranian nuclear enrichment, with officials like JD Vance and Marco Rubio demanding concrete actions over verbal promises.
gulf_states.intelligence_notes: Operational activity in Iran is noted via reports of unmarked 747 freighters in Tabriz and helicopter activity in Pardis. The IDF's focus on 'civil defense' covers for Hamas operatives suggests a continued intelligence effort to identify embedded combatants in Gaza.
